tei:div.tei:p: 159) ༄༅/ dpal dus gsum sangs rgyas sprul pa'i sku// rje kun mkhyen ngag gi dbang por 'dud// mi bdag gi bsam tshul sna tshogs 'di// brtags brtags na smyon pa bzang ma 'dra// sems 'dod chags 'di yi dran lugs la// nor dmar dmar mthong tshad mkho mkho 'dra// mig bsod nams ldan pas mthong tshad kun// lag bsod nams zad pas len thabs med// lag lon kyang kha ru za rgyu dang*// rgyab gyon rgyu mi 'khyag mi ltogs tsam/ med thabs med de min rgyu zas kun// dgra g.yab mo yin pa mthong chos red// mkho med de dgos med dam bca' zungs// byad legs legs bu mo mthong tshad kun// mi bdag gi grogs mo byed snying 'dod// rgyal khams kyi mtshar sdug yin tshad kun// bsten mi nus kha zhabs lon mi srid// de srid kyang mje gog gis mi nus// tshe gzhon dus phal cher tshul 'chos kyi// dus 'das bas nag mo dbang ma song// da lo shas song na rgas 'khog gi /gzugs mi sdug ston ni ran shing snang*// dus de tshe nag mos kha mi ya// dus da lta skra lo skya phyed dang*/ sngo phyed du song ba ma mthong ngam// lo shas kyi 'dug rogs nag mo ni// dgos na ni bstan pa'i mig ltos dang*// chos 'dul ba'i bstan bshig s+t+wa re yin/ khyed mi lus lan gcig thob pa des// bstan pa la phan par ma nus kyang*// 160) bstan bshig gi s+t+wa re ma byed ang*// mo btsal yang kha rog lon mi 'gyur// shi gson gyi dkor rdzas mo'i rin du// gtong dgos na gson las shi ba dga'// lon na yang dang po mthong dga' dang*// 'dzum skyid kyis lung pa gang na yang*// bar du ni lta lugs yag nyes dang*// tshig 'jam rtsub tsam la srin mo kho// khong 'khrug pa'i zug ngu bzod mi nus// rang gnod pa'i dgra bo phug bzhag 'di// mi 'dod ni ngo ma kho thag chod// tha ma ni bu tsha khyim gang gis/ gzhis ngan ni 'bu tshang tsam zhig chags*// de rnams kyang na la son pas na// rang rang dang 'dod mthun grogs re bstan/

pha rgan dang ma rgan rgyang du phud// lan chags ni 'khor med sems la gzan// dus de tshe 'gyod kyang phyis pa lags// de 'dra ba 'ong na kho thag chod*// dus da lta dpyod na dpyod re ran// ran pa las 'phyi bar 'gyur ram snyam// stu dga'i sems khong nas phyung snying 'dod// mje gog 'di rtsad nas gcod snying 'dod// deng sang gi bla ser mchog dman kun// mo dga' 'dis bla rkub gra rkub phud// mi khram pa rai 'gas gter ston dang*/ sngags pa yin zer nas gzhan mgo g.yogs/ tshe 'di gang skyid kyang phyi ma yi// las ngan ni tshabs cher bsags bsags pas// las rgyu 'bras rgyal ba'i dbang pos kyang*// bdag gi 161) ru bzhes na phyi ma yi// yab yul ni legs po med thag chod// phal cher gyi dngos su ser mo ni// yin kha kha chos gos snam sbyar gyon// lkog tu ni chang dang bud med bsten// phal cher ni 'di med phyi med kyi/ mdo 'dra mas ser khyim kho na byed// de thams cad mo 'dod stu dga' dang*// mje rgod 'di mgo ma khug pas lan// dgra 'di bas che ba khams gsum na// btsal na yang rnyed par mi 'gyur bas// dgra 'di la bag zon ma 'chugs ang*// tshig khyed khyod tsam gyi brjod lugs la// sems dga' sdug gi re dogs che lugs la// nor cung zad dgra yis khyer ba na/ bu lon dang lan chags 'khor ba yi/ bsam shes na bsod nams tshogs rdzogs kyang*// rgyud khong khro 'di yi che lugs la/ kha dmod ngan 'di yi mang lugs la// dgras nor rdzas khyer ba'i yus chen 'di// rkya mi sngon lang nas bshad lugs la// rkang thang sngon sdod nas bshad lugs la// rgyud nor rdzas 'dzin pa che lugs la// dus da lo phyag phreng dmag gzing gi /rgyu nor kun dbang du sdud pa'i tshe// nor khab rtse tsam gyi thog tu yang*// bla rkub dang grwa rkub bud lugs la// bsam bsam na rang gi rang nyid la// sems khrel bas smyon pa 'dre rgod ni// rang nyid las che ba khams gsum na// btsal

162)na yang rnyed par mi 'gyur bas// dus da ni dran shes bag yod kyis// rgyud 'di nyid chos la bkol bar gyis// bkol ma thub u thug red na ni// rnam rtog kho rang sar yan du chugs/ rtog med kyi chos sku'i rang sa zungs/ phaṭaḥ dge'o//
